about: Cursor summarizes on its server mid-turn and SDK 1.0.31 streams nothing about it. Decoded, the marker cites the window as the saved reader's does and says what the context held before; the meter waits with no fill. The run's next reading (100947, the call after the summary's input and output) completes the same marker in place with what the summary left and fills the meter.
